Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Initially freaked out as during my burn-in after 25 minutes grill temp was at 225? Made no sense as I could see that all 3 burners were lit so I immediately called Weber. Explained the situation and the guy told me he hopefully has a cure. We shut off the grill valves and closed the propane bottle. After a few minutes he instructed me to open the propane bottle very very slowly which I did and guess what? The grill came to life like a flame thrower. 

Tech explained to me that the propane bottle regulator had gone into a protective mode as it falsely detected a problem. And further stated that had I not done the corrective measures quickly it may have never come back to life (would have replaced at no charge). Said this is a situation with new regulator guidelines. Upon further investigation there is even mention of this in the manual (but let's be honest, who reads a gas grill manual)? 

Now the better news...this grill gets to temp very fast and 600-650 for steaks is a few minutes away. I've only grilled 5 times as a new owner but after examination I think this grill will be serving me for a long time.

Thanks Weber for having a phone technician available. Great customer service.
Results.Title: Weber Customer Service to the Rescue...Wow
